comments.author: Ellistrae
comments.body:
Part of Memorial Album "Exquisite Sweets of the World" that requires 10 total recipes (9 cooking, 1 storage & 2 are from Florence NPC): Honey Pancake, Galette, Fondant mille crepes, Che (SE Asia Secret Cuisines- Land), Zenzai, Yaksik, Sweet Potato Congee, Fried Sesame Balls, Macaron (Cooking Florence Recipe) & Almond Sherbet (Storage Florence Recipe).

Reward is Fruit Knife - +1 Cooking +1 Handicrafts in Nantes with Princess Marguerite.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Also available from the Tavern clerks of Tunis, Alexandria, and Istanbul. As with all clerk shops, if an item is sold out, check back and it'll be restocked within five real life minutes of the time it sold out.

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
I see 2 aide bazaars in London selling these for 100k-1m, at the moment. One honey pancake is required to continue in the Atlantis story line quest:
Those Who Seek and Those Who Lead (London Adventure Guild, Search R1, Appraisal R1, English)
